faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The usual questions about orders, delivery and payment.
faq.stillStuckHint: Our team answers during business hours.

orders.title: Orders
orders.q1: How do I track my order?
orders.a1: Under "My orders" you can see every stage from payment to delivery, with the date and time of each change.
orders.q2: Can I change an order I already placed?
orders.a2: Once confirmed an order cannot be edited, because the stock is already reserved. Cancel and place a new one, or contact the store.
orders.q3: Can I repeat a previous shop?
orders.a3: Yes. Save your cart as a list under "My lists" and send it all back to the cart whenever you like.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.a1: The estimate appears at checkout before you confirm, calculated from your postcode. Store pickup is usually ready in 30 minutes.
delivery.q2: Do you deliver to my address?
delivery.a2: Checkout confirms whether your postcode is inside {store}’s delivery area. If it is not, store pickup is still available.
delivery.q3: What if I am not home?
delivery.a3: The driver will call the number on the order. You can leave access instructions in the note field at checkout.

payment.title: Payment
payment.a1: Yes, after 30 minutes. You can generate a fresh code on the same order page afterwards.
payment.a2: PIX confirms immediately: the order page updates itself as soon as the bank confirms, with no need to refresh.

returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.q1: I received the wrong or a damaged item.
returns.a1: Contact the store within 7 days with your order number. Perishables are assessed on the delivery day itself.
returns.a2: The amount goes back by the same payment method. PIX refunds usually land within two business days.
